A garrison of dwarves guards a treasure in a circular room deep in the mines west of Kazordoon. Go down five floors full of dwarves, pass the level 32 door and fight your way to the bottom of the circular room to receive a {item:Dwarven Axe} and a {item:War Hammer}.
A garrison of dwarves guards a valuable treasure in a room deep below the surface.
Level 32 for the {item:Door of Expertise} (40+ recommended).
keep it handy to escape from the final room if needed
Distance weapons or runes to kill the Dwarf Geomancers quickly

Do not underestimate this quest: the circular room has a fast respawn and the {creature:Dwarf Geomancer|Dwarf Geomancers}, {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} come from all sides.
Dwarf Geomancers drain mana (0–80) and heal quickly. Kill them first, from a distance or with runes.

Go to **Kazordoon** and enter the indicated dwarf mine, on the surface **west** of the city ({coord:32495,31975,7}). You are in a very small cave with one or two {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves}. Go down a floor.
Follow the path **northeast**, as on the map, and go down the hole.
Follow the path **north** and then **east** and go down the hole.
Follow the path **south**, **west** and then **north** and go down the hole.
Watch out for the groups of {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}.
Go **straight south** and go down the hole. It is a short path, but there are lots of small groups of {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} coming from both sides.

Follow the path **south**, **west** and **north** through the middle of the {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}. Pass the **level 32** {item:Door of Expertise}. Before you go down the next hole, have the {item:Rope} ready for a quick exit.
Path on the 5th floor to the level 32 door and the hole
Down there you will be attacked by many {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}, {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and {creature:Dwarf Geomancer|Dwarf Geomancers}.
Cross the room along the east side
Go down into the circular room. Fight your way through the dwarves to the **south** end of the room. Stay on the **east** side: that way you avoid most of the dwarves and save mana.
The circular room and the quest crates at the south end
Kill the {creature:Dwarf Geomancer|Dwarf Geomancers} quickly, with distance weapons or runes. Be careful in melee: they heal quickly and can lure you into a group of dwarves.
At the **south** end of the room are the quest crates. Open them to receive the rewards.

There is no shortcut: go back the same way. Leave the circular room through the hole you came down by using the {item:Rope} (it is the quick escape if the room fills with dwarves) and repeat the maps in reverse, going up with the Rope at each hole: 5th, 4th, 3rd, 2nd and 1st floor. At the end you go up to the small entrance cave and come out onto the surface at {coord:32495,31975,7}, west of Kazordoon.
